title: 第6章  新来的师妹不对劲
slug: 我一杂役怎么成掌门孩子他爹了
content_zh:
“宋执事，她的确是我师妹，还希望你能给我个面子，不要为难她如何？”
叶长天当即抬头望向了宋浩，淡淡地开口道。
“叶长天，你不过是个废物一般的杂役弟子，让我给你面子，你配吗？”
“识相点就立马滚远点，否则我保证让你在杂役峰混不下去。”
宋浩一脸轻蔑地冷笑起来。
他可是杂役峰炼气三层的执事，父亲更是杂役峰长老，炼气九层的修为，在这杂役峰几乎可以横着走的存在。
区区一个叶长天，宋浩又岂会放在眼中？
“宋执事真是好大的威风呢。”
叶长天撇了撇嘴，笑着道：“既然杂役峰没有我的容身之地，我申请晋升外门弟子。”
“就你，还晋升外门弟子？”
宋浩仿佛听到了这个世上最好笑的笑话，忍不住大声讥笑起来。
太玄宗杂役弟子都是些什么玩意，他可是非常清楚。
除了偶尔有那么一两个走了狗屎运的家伙，想要靠自己修炼到炼气三层晋升外门弟子，几乎就是不可能的事情。
这叶长天不仅是伪灵根的废物，而且还将大部分时间花费在杂物活上。
最重要的是。
这傻逼辛辛苦苦打杂赚来的资源，一点没用在自己身上，全都拿去舔他那位身在内门的未婚妻了。
就这货也能修炼到炼气三层晋升外门弟子？
简直是痴心妄想！
“宋执事，按照太玄宗的规定，杂役弟子修为达到炼气三层就能晋升外门弟子。”
“我既然达到了条件，来晋升外门弟子有问题吗？”

叶长天无视了宋浩的嘲讽，目光平静地道。
“你说你达到了炼气三层是吧？”
宋浩对着叶长天勾了勾手指，脸庞上尽是挑衅的神色：
“来来来，不要说我没给你机会，我也是炼气三层的修为，想要晋升外门弟子，打赢我就行！”
随着宋浩此话一出。
众人望向叶长天的目中，都是忍不住浮现出了一抹怜悯的神色。
宋浩不仅是老牌的炼气三层，父亲更是杂役峰长老，修炼的功法绝技也不是普通杂役弟子能够相提并论的。
叶长天就算真的达到了炼气三层，想要击败宋浩也绝无可能。
宋浩摆明了就是不想让叶长天晋升外门弟子。
以宋浩心狠手辣、嚣张霸道的行事风格，他甚至极有可能要借此机会废了叶长天，让叶长天永远都没有翻身的可能！
而在叶长天身旁。
月青霜眨了眨灵动的大眼睛，就这么静静地看着叶长天。
师尊既然如此推崇叶长天，还说出那么不正经的话来，足以证明叶长天并非普通杂役弟子那么简单。
她也想看看，叶长天要如何应付眼前的情形。
“宋执事，你确定？”
叶长天抬头看着宋浩，嘴角掀起了一抹玩味的笑容。
“废话少说，动手吧。”
宋浩背负双手，缓缓来到叶长天面前，一脸大度地道：“我宋浩也不是那种喜欢欺负同门的人，给你个先出手的机会。”
他可是炼气三层巅峰的修为，距离炼气四层仅有一步之遥。
就算叶长天侥幸达到了炼气三层，在他面前也掀不起什么浪花来。

“宋执事不愧是宋执事，果然是气度非凡呢。”
叶长天对着宋浩竖了个大拇指，笑眯眯地道：“不过宋执事你这么客气，我怎么好意思呢。”
然而——
叶长天嘴里说着不好意思，身体却很诚实。
他虽然拥有炼气四层巅峰的修为，但却是个没有任何战斗经验的水货。
既然宋浩非要装逼让他一招，他也没必要客气。
叶长天全力催动炼气四层巅峰的力量，瞬间汇聚于拳头之上，然后毫无保留地一拳朝着宋浩轰了过去。
这一刻。
原本负手而立，根本没将叶长天放在眼中的宋浩，神色不由猛然大变。
炼气四层！
这小子怎么会是炼气四层？
宋浩又惊又怒，连忙催动体内力量抵挡这突如其来的一拳。
只是——
宋浩本就只有炼气三层的修为，仓促之下又如何能够抵挡叶长天全力出手的一拳。
只听见一声巨响，宋浩整个人都是瞬间倒飞而出，重重地砸落出好几米，嘴里一口忍不住鲜血狂喷了出来。
“你你……怎么可能？”
宋浩面色惨白，嘴里发出了一阵不可置信的尖叫。
而周围的那些杂役弟子，此刻都是如同石化了一般，久久难以从惊骇中回过神来。
宋浩竟然被叶长天一招秒了！
这岂不是意味着，叶长天真的要晋升外门弟子了？

这一刻。
所有杂役弟子望向叶长天的目光，都是露出了羡慕嫉妒恨的神色。
“宋执事，你没事吧？”
“我这刚突破不久，下手没轻没重的，也没想到宋执事这么不经打，见谅啊。”
叶长天有些抱歉地说了一句，然后笑眯眯地问道：“我现在有资格晋升外门弟子了么？”
“我会将此事上报外门，你回去等消息吧。”
宋浩抹了一把嘴角的血迹，神情显得阴翳无比。
他被叶长天给阴了。
要是早知道叶长天有炼气四层的修为，他刚才直接祭出老爹给他的防身法宝，也不至于装逼不成反被艹了！
宋浩在太玄宗杂役峰横行霸道这么多年，还从来没吃过这么大的亏。
他一定要让叶长天为此付出代价！
反正他一日不上报，叶长天就还是杂役峰的杂役弟子。
只要叶长天还在杂役峰，他就有无数种方法收拾叶长天！
到时候。
他要让叶长天知道什么是生不如死！
他要让叶长天亲眼目睹自己是如何将他这位绝色师妹压在身下！
“那就多谢宋执事了。”
叶长天笑着说了一句，然后就带着月青霜回到了住处。
他看了一眼身旁的月青霜，笑着道：“青霜师妹，我先帮你找个没人住的房间住下吧。”
这一位现在可是他的金主，他自然要伺候到位才行。

“长天师兄，我胆子小，不敢一个人住，我要跟你住一起。”
月青霜眨了眨眼睛，一双美眸在叶长天身上不断地审视着。
想着师尊让他来找叶长天的目的，月青霜绝美的脸庞上也是浮现出了一抹动人的红晕。
她也没想到，师尊给她的方法会是如此的不正经。
竟然让她来找叶长天双修！
不过——
与这样一位帅气双修，好像也并不是不能接受呢。
“青霜师妹，你……你没事吧？”
叶长天看着月青霜那一副想要吃了自己的神情，顿时忍不住心生一种古怪的想法。
这新来的师妹，怕不是馋他的身子吧？
content_en:
"Deacon Song, she is indeed my junior sister. I hope you can give me some face and don't embarrass her."
Ye Changtian immediately looked up at Song Hao and said calmly.
"Ye Changtian, you are just a useless handyman disciple. Are you worthy of asking me to give you face?"
"If you understand, get away immediately, otherwise I guarantee that you will not be able to survive in the Miscellaneous Peak."
Song Hao sneered with contempt.
He is a deacon of the third level of Qi Refining at the Miscellaneous Peak, and his father is the elder of the Miscellaneous Peak. With a cultivation level of the ninth level of Qi Refining, he can almost walk sideways on the Miscellaneous Peak.
How could Song Hao take Ye Changtian seriously?
"Deacon Song is so majestic."
Ye Changtian curled his lips and said with a smile: "Since there is no place for me in the Handler Peak, I will apply to be promoted to an outer disciple."
"You are the only one who is promoted to an outer disciple?"
Song Hao seemed to have heard the funniest joke in the world and couldn't help laughing loudly.
He knew very well what the handyman disciples of Taixuan Sect were doing.
Except for the occasional lucky guy or two, it is almost impossible to reach the third level of Qi Refining and be promoted to an outer disciple by yourself.
This Ye Changtian is not only a waste of pseudo-spiritual roots, but also spends most of his time doing chores.
The most important thing is.
The resources that this fool earned through hard work were not used on himself at all. They were all used to lick his fiancée who was in the inner sect.
Can this guy reach the third level of Qi Refining and be promoted to an outer disciple?
It’s simply wishful thinking!
"Deacon Song, according to the regulations of Taixuan Sect, servant disciples can be promoted to outer disciples if they reach the third level of Qi Refining."
"Since I have met the conditions, is there any problem with being promoted to an outer disciple?"
Ye Changtian ignored Song Hao's ridicule and said calmly.
"You said you reached the third level of Qi refining, right?"
Song Hao raised his fingers at Ye Changtian, with a provocative look on his face:
"Come on, come on, don't say I didn't give you a chance. I am also at the third level of Qi Refining. If you want to be promoted to an outer disciple, just beat me!"
As soon as Song Hao said this.
Everyone couldn't help but have a look of pity in their eyes when they looked at Ye Changtian.
Song Hao is not only a veteran of the third level of Qi Refining, but his father is also an elder of the handyman peak. The skills and skills he cultivates are not comparable to those of ordinary handyman disciples.
Even if Ye Changtian really reaches the third level of Qi Refining, it is absolutely impossible to defeat Song Hao.
Song Hao made it clear that he did not want Ye Changtian to be promoted to an outer disciple.
With Song Hao's ruthless, arrogant and domineering style, he may even take this opportunity to destroy Ye Changtian, so that Ye Changtian will never have the possibility of turning over!
And next to Ye Changtian.
Yue Qingshuang blinked her big, smart eyes and looked at Ye Changtian quietly.
Since Master admired Ye Changtian so much and said such unorthodox words, it was enough to prove that Ye Changtian was not just an ordinary handyman disciple.
She also wanted to see how Ye Changtian would deal with the situation in front of him.
"Deacon Song, are you sure?"
Ye Changtian looked up at Song Hao, with a playful smile on his lips.
"Stop talking nonsense and let's do it."
Song Hao put his hands behind his back, slowly came to Ye Changtian, and said with a magnanimous face: "I, Song Hao, am not the kind of person who likes to bully my fellow disciples. I will give you a chance to strike first."
He is at the peak of the third level of Qi refining, and is only one step away from the fourth level of Qi refining.
Even if Ye Changtian was lucky enough to reach the third level of Qi Refining, he wouldn't be able to make any waves in front of him.
"Deacon Song is worthy of being Deacon Song. He is indeed very magnanimous."
Ye Changtian gave Song Hao a thumbs up and said with a smile: "But Deacon Song, you are so polite, how can I be embarrassed?"
However——
Ye Changtian said he was embarrassed, but his body was honest.
Although he has the cultivation level of the fourth level of Qi refining, he isA parallel import without any combat experience.
Since Song Hao insisted on pretending to let him take a move, there was no need for him to be polite.
Ye Changtian used all his strength to mobilize the power of the fourth level of Qi Refining, which instantly gathered on his fist, and then punched Song Hao without reservation.
This moment.
Song Hao, who was standing with his hands behind his back and not paying attention to Ye Changtian at all, couldn't help but change his expression suddenly.
Fourth level of Qi refining!
How could this kid be at the fourth level of Qi Refining?
Song Hao was shocked and angry, and quickly mobilized his body's strength to resist the sudden punch.
Just——
Song Hao was only at the third level of Qi Refining, so how could he resist Ye Changtian's full-strength punch in a hurry.
There was only a loud noise, and Song Hao flew out instantly, falling heavily for several meters, and blood spurted out from his mouth.
"You...how is that possible?"
Song Hao's face turned pale, and he let out an unbelievable scream.
The handyman disciples around them seemed to have turned to stone at this moment, and it was difficult for them to recover from the shock for a long time.
Song Hao was instantly killed by Ye Changtian!
Doesn't this mean that Ye Changtian is really going to be promoted to an outer disciple?
This moment.
All the handyman disciples looked at Ye Changtian with expressions of envy, jealousy and hatred.
"Deacon Song, are you okay?"
"I just broke through not long ago, so I didn't strike lightly or harshly. I didn't expect Deacon Song to be so careless. Please forgive me."
Ye Changtian said apologetically, and then asked with a smile: "Am I qualified to be promoted to an outer disciple now?"
"I will report this matter to the outer door. You can go back and wait for the news."
Song Hao wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, his expression looking extremely gloomy.
He was betrayed by Ye Changtian.
If he had known that Ye Changtian had the fourth level of Qi Refining, he would have just used the self-defense magic weapon that his father gave him just now, and he would not have been cheated after he failed to show off!
Song Hao has been domineering in Taixuanzong's Miscellaneous Peak for so many years, but he has never suffered such a big loss.
He must make Ye Changtian pay the price for this!
Anyway, if he didn't report it for a day, Ye Changtian would still be a handyman disciple of the handyman peak.
As long as Ye Changtian is still at Handyman Peak, he will have countless ways to deal with Ye Changtian!
That's when.
He wants Ye Changtian to know what life is worse than death!
He wanted Ye Changtian to witness with his own eyes how he suppressed his stunning junior sister!
"Thank you very much, Deacon Song."
Ye Changtian said with a smile, and then returned to his residence with Yue Qingshuang.
He glanced at Yue Qingshuang beside him and said with a smile: "Junior Sister Qingshuang, let me help you find an unoccupied room to stay in first."
This person is now his financial sponsor, so he naturally has to take care of him.
"Senior Brother Changtian, I am too timid to live alone. I want to live with you."
Yue Qingshuang blinked her eyes, her beautiful eyes constantly examining Ye Changtian.
Thinking about the purpose why his master asked him to come to Ye Changtian, a touching blush appeared on Yue Qingshuang's beautiful face.
She also didn't expect that the method given to her by her master would be so unorthodox.
He actually asked her to come to Ye Changtian for dual cultivation!
But——
It seems that it is not unacceptable to have such a handsome double cultivator.
"Junior sister Qingshuang, are you...are you okay?"
Ye Changtian looked at Yue Qingshuang's expression of wanting to eat him, and suddenly couldn't help but have a strange thought in his mind.
Is this new junior sister just greedy for his body?
